Honestly brother, looking at this new account, it was made in July and already switched usernames once. The link in bio is a shallow redirect and literally just has pure solicitation. Look on the outside, the intent of this account couldn't be more obvious. Especially paired with a link that is only for adult adjacent conversion. I think really realizing that trust score with new accounts paired with solicitory language, especially in the link is cursed from the beginning. The link aggregator is known to be associated with adult adjacent creators. It itself renders a shallow transparent view from the outside of what's on the other side. It's just a redirect to a /VIP of the current page. Its servers different  metadata to different sources, and has some kind of deep link built into it.

Realize this sits on Meta's page. It's extremely easy to crawl this. It was just a matter of time. I think that knowing how young this account is, you got to slow down and take your time. Build the account organically. Don't try and solicit off-platform so quickly. It's not 2024. We can't do that shit anymore so brazenly unless you really have expendable accounts and thats your strat. Really it takes time, I think, to build trust. If you've already had two accounts banned, you're just playing a high-risk strategy. You better have 100 more ready to go all virgin IPs tied to each individual one, harvested with its own Gmail, its own tick tock, its own everything, using its own metal. Even then you should probably lose about 70% of them moving at high velocity.

Yeah Im on a 7 day trial, feel like thats the minimum to get away with and having a decent sub conversion like that but also feel like chatters definitely get overwhelmed at times. As my traffic becomes a bit more consistent I will probably go 8.99 with full discount like you said.

To be really honest, though I have really seen damn near every fucking type of configuration be successful. I’ve seen the same configurations fail. I am a believer that if you put everything into it and you’re willing to pivot, if if it’s not working out, you will fucking figure it out I promise, and there are endless ways to do it.

I currently have a few free pages that don’t convert to VIP funnels yet. in the past, I mean, I’ve seen three pages easily crack 100,000 a month. A lot of of them definitely went live pretty frequently but very doable.
Currently, we do have a free page that does very well, but there is a gating system on it. There’s a VIP system on it. The model had a real intention with it and it functions really well though because it’s like a big enough magnet for people to get through the door, but it’s systematic in your access to even be able to chat. There’s a lot of ways to create gates and filtration systems on free pages and then they can be excellent.
At scale, we’ve just found that we perform really well with Free, Paige to VIP, funnels and slowly mature and train the fans that the free Paige doesn’t even have explicit content if the model does explicit, and slowly the price scales up
